alias_permutation_limitation: Permutation 2 is adjudicated sequentially by the same GPT-5.6 Sol conversation, not an independent model context. It is an alias/order-invariance audit, not proof that latent model memory is absent.

evidence_ablation_rule.scope: For each provisional PASS driver, remove all evidence IDs cited for each accepted member edge and re-adjudicate that edge using only the remaining point-in-time evidence for that alias.
evidence_ablation_rule.material_dependence: An edge passes dependence if confidence falls by at least 0.20 OR falls below 0.70 OR the edge is removed.
evidence_ablation_rule.driver_level_pass: At least 75% of accepted member edges must pass evidence dependence, and after removing unsupported edges the driver must still satisfy the original minimum company/cluster rules.
evidence_ablation_rule.no_retuning_after_ablation: Thresholds and driver definitions are not changed in response to ablation results.
